failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1: 'there is no information in the passages about who played Hunt in "The Calling (2009 film)"' and Summary 2: 'the passages do not identify who played a character named "Hunt" in the film' — both summaries correctly recognize missing evidence but neither specifies the concrete missing entity (the cast list of The Calling 2009 film, or the name of the actress who played Hunt).

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2: 'Who played Hunt in "The Calling (2009 film)" and what is she best known for?' — natural-language yes/no question format bundling two targets (who played Hunt + what she's known for) rather than entity names.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
